subject: [hw] opus-perf -> IV/IP: n2vhost guest_main traces every instruction unconditionally (perf: product risk)
body: host/n2vhost.c:430 guest_main() calls n2a32_trace_attach(c) always, also in library mode (vcodecd links it). With c->trace != NULL the core calls T01 n2a32_trace_insn() per guest instruction: describe(addr) symbol lookup + a formatted record, i.e. microseconds per instruction instead of ~30 ns. Proposal: attach only when N2HW_TRACE (or an explicit n2vhost option) is set; the M-c evidence already comes from n2vcu_stats(). Child guest threads (V32) are not traced, only the main guest thread. Please confirm/fix (IV owns n2vhost.c).
